Use this procedure when handling a puzzle in a Continual-ARC stream.

Preserve demos as received; never use a sparse reconstruction or hand-derived expected output, since transcription errors can masquerade as rule failures. from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    """Match the lower color-1 stencil to its duplicate above the divider;
    move the other upper object directly above the stencil, and remove the
    upper panel and divider (retaining the lower 9-row panel).

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
